_comment: The 409 of PATCH /plans/{id} and POST /plans/{id}/waves/auto while a migration of the plan is in flight (SDD §12): each VM with what releases it. Shared by seamless/tests/test_in_flight.py and dashboard/src/api/mock.test.ts. Each case: the blocking migrations (VM name, phase, whether the source VM is stopped) and the change they block -> the message.

cases.expected: finish, roll back or cancel the migration in flight (web-01) before editing the plan
cases.note: 1. one migration waiting for its cutover: the wording before the groups

cases.expected: finalize or roll back the completed migrations (dc2-01, dc2-02, dc2-03, dc2-04, dc2-05, dc2-06, dc2-07, dc2-08, dc2-09, dc2-10 and 2 more) before editing the plan
cases.note: 2. a completed migration is finished and cannot be cancelled: finalize or roll back (SDD §8.1); ten names, sorted, then how many more

cases.expected: roll back or retry the failed migration whose source VM is stopped (db-01) before re-planning the waves
cases.note: 3. a failed cutover left the source stopped: a cancel is refused (SDD §5.1)

cases.expected: roll back or retry the failed migration whose source VM is stopped (db-01); finish, roll back or cancel the migrations in flight (app-01, app-02); finalize or roll back the completed migrations (web-01, web-02) before editing the plan
cases.note: 4. most urgent first: a stopped source (the VM is down), then the migrations in flight, then those awaiting finalize

cases.expected: finish, roll back or cancel the migration in flight (app-03) before editing the plan
cases.note: 5. a retry keeps a stopped source's clock open (SDD §5.2): the plan cuts it over when it runs

cases.expected: finish, roll back or cancel the migrations in flight (sync-01, sync-02, sync-03, sync-04, sync-05, sync-06, sync-07, sync-08, sync-09, sync-10) before re-planning the waves
cases.note: 6. exactly ten names: none left out

cases.expected: roll back or retry the failed migrations whose source VM is stopped (db-01, db-02) before editing the plan
cases.note: 7. two failed cutovers that stopped their sources
